pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with diffuse, soft-edged pixel gradients. Darker regions show higher spatial area on the neck and shoulder, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented geometric shapes on the posterior flank and hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways. Pixel thickness is relatively uniform across the neck but increases in width at the junction nodes on the lower flank. Primary topology consists of tri-radial intersections.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder ridge. The mane contour is visible as a consistent textured fringe against the background.
